decision_description: Populated Tier 3 project_brief/ (concept_note.md, project_summary.json, strategic_positioning.md) and architecture_inputs/ (objectives.json, outcomes.json, impacts.json, workpackage_seed.json, risks.json, milestones_seed.json) by a one-time HAND-LIFT from the source_grounded methodology vault MSCA/methodology_graph/ (pinned gitlink SHA b4d9e57, per reinstantiation_provenance.json). The milestone-2 deterministic graph compiler (D2-A/D9) will later regenerate Tier 3 from the same vault and diff against this hand-lift, which is its test fixture.
provenance_discipline: Appendix B (PHASE8_FULLSCALE_AND_OBSIDIAN_GRILL_BRIEF.md): source_grounded -> Confirmed; synthesis -> Inferred (framing); inference -> Inferred; unconfirmed -> NOT lifted as fact (Unresolved). Only source_grounded vault content is lifted as Confirmed; synthesis/inference nodes are lifted at most as Inferred and flagged in-artifact; no unconfirmed vault node is lifted as a Tier 3 fact and no vault inference is promoted to a Tier 3 fact. Per-fact source vault node and evidence_strength recorded in hand_lift_provenance.json and inline in each artifact.
spine_handling: The identity spine is deliberately left Unresolved and enumerated (honest block, D17): fellow (Unresolved), host (Unresolved), supervisor (Unresolved, absent from vault), validation/associated partners and data providers (Unresolved). ELTE is REFUTED (absent from all sources; do not invent a role), not merely unconfirmed. Role tokens FELLOW/HOST/SUPERVISOR stand for structural roles of any MSCA-PF action with identities Unresolved; no name is invented (CLAUDE.md §13.3). Each gap carries a confirmation action in call_binding/confirmation_checklist.json.
call_binding: selected_call.json carries the OPERATOR-CONFIRMED MSCA-PF call (HORIZON-MSCA-2026-PF-01, instrument MSCA-PF, deadline 2026-09-09, action_confirmation_ref to action-confirmation-msca-pf_2026-07-13.json). The vault is silent on the specific call; the binding was confirmed externally, not guessed by the engine. If the operator cannot stand behind it, it is to be declared via working_assumptions.json (ticket 15), never guessed.
assumed_scaffolding: Fellowship type (EF/GF) and project duration are Unresolved; the architecture_inputs timeline/effort seeds use a 24-month European-Fellowship WORKING SCAFFOLD flagged Assumed throughout (not Confirmed). The unit-cost budget is not a Tier 3 fact (derived in Phase 7, ticket 8; host coefficient blocked until the host is confirmed or beta-declared).
tier_authority_applied: CLAUDE.md §5 Tier 3, §9.4/§9.5 (durable/reproducible decisions), §10.6 (source documents govern; generic knowledge flagged), §12.2 (validation-status categories), §13.3 (no fabricated project facts); MILESTONE1_DECISION_RECORD.md D11/D17; PHASE8_FULLSCALE_AND_OBSIDIAN_GRILL_BRIEF.md Appendix B.
rationale: Tier 3 must hold grounded project data so the engine can run Phases 1-8 against the confirmed methodology while blocking honestly on the unconfirmed spine (D17). Lifting only source_grounded content as Confirmed, flagging synthesis/inference as Inferred, and refusing to lift unconfirmed identity gives the run real substance without fabricating the researcher/host/call spine - the honest block that makes gate failure a valid terminal state (§12.4).
